answers.answer: 1. Four players use 3 randomly chosen Pods; lowest number in A, next in B, alternating A/B; all Locked side up. 2. Bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 3 Adults plus 1 Adult per player (7 Adults total).

1. Remove objectives marked for higher player counts; shuffle Corporate and Personal decks separately and deal each player one of each, hidden. 2. Choose one at First Encounter, when an Intruder first appears; remove other face down unseen. 3. Eggs are not Intruders and do not trigger this choice.

1. Discard the used Action card plus exactly two additional Action cards, face up to own discard pile. With the stated hand, discard the used card and two others; one Action card remains. 2. Contamination cannot pay. 3. If the card has OR sections, choose one section.
answers.evidence: Actions: Action Cost; Actions from Action cards

answers.answer: 1. A Character ending their own round in a burning Room takes 1 Light Wound. 2. Passing ends their normal Actions for the Player Phase. 3. When passing, may discard any number of hand cards. 4. Fire wound occurs once after that Character's round; later players' rounds do not burn them again that turn.

1. Entering flips an unexplored tile and resolves its token; orient tile so token's item number faces Item Counter. 2. Resolve and remove token to box. 3. If empty, Noise roll; 1–4 places marker in numbered connected Corridor (including Technical Entrance if applicable); full Corridor triggers Encounter. 4. Silence gives no roll; Slime makes Silence Danger. Danger moves all eligible neighboring non-Combat Intruders in; if none, put Noise in each unmarked connected Corridor. Occupied destination means no Noise roll.
answers.evidence: Movement, Rooms and Corridors; Exploration tokens; Noise roll

answers.answer: 1. Careful Movement costs 2 Action cards and replaces the post-move Noise roll with placing Noise in a chosen Corridor connected to destination. 2. Forbidden in Combat and if all destination connected Corridors already contain Noise; follows normal movement rules. 3. Closed Door blocks crossing. 4. No one can stop in a Corridor.
answers.evidence: Basic Actions: Careful Movement; Movement, Rooms, and Corridors

answers.answer: 1. Attempted Noise placement on an already marked Corridor triggers Encounter: discard all Noise in Corridors connected to Room (including Tech entrance), draw token, place matching mini if nonblank. 2. Drawn token is set aside outside bag; it returns only by applicable rule (e.g. Tech Corridors). 3. Compare token number to triggering player's Action AND Contamination hand cards: fewer cards than number means Surprise Attack. 4. Contamination cards count.

1. Danger moves ALL eligible neighboring Intruders not in Combat. 2. If none, place Noise in every connected unmarked Corridor (Tech if entrance). 3. Intruder movement into Character Room is not an Encounter, though it creates Combat. 4. Character Slime turns Silence into Danger.

1. Encounter Blank places Noise in every connected Corridor; no mini appears. 2. Return Blank to bag. 3. If it was last token in bag, add an Adult if available, otherwise none. 4. Bag development Blank adds an Adult if available, then returns Blank; no Encounter Noise procedure is stated.
answers.evidence: Blank token in an Encounter; Intruder bag development

answers.answer: 1. Intruders trying to move through a Closed Door destroy it simultaneously and stay in originating Room. 2. Door lies destroyed; movement can cross but it cannot be closed again (except Plasma Torch). 3. Noise-triggered appearance through a Closed Door is not blocked; Intruder appears regardless.

1. Intruder entering Tech Corridors disappears; remove miniature and all Injury markers. 2. Return its token to bag. 3. Noise marker there remains. 4. Characters normally cannot use Tech Corridors (Mechanic card and Technical Corridor Plans exceptions); Doors cannot be placed there.

1. Shoot costs 1 Action card and 1 Ammo; target Intruder in same Room using Weapon in Hand. 2. Melee costs 1 Action card, draws Contamination onto Action discard, targets Intruder in same Room. 3. Shoot miss has no Wound; Melee miss inflicts 1 Serious Wound. 4. Double hit is 2 Injuries by Shoot, 1 by Melee; Weapon modifiers may apply.

1. Larva dies at 1 Injury. 2. Adult: draw 1 Attack card, blood value ≤ total Injuries kills; Queen draws 2 and sums blood; ≤ total Injuries kills. Retreat arrow overrides numerical result. 3. Death of Adult/Queen removes mini and places Carcass in Room; Larva has no Carcass. 4. Either Queen card showing Retreat makes it flee via Event card Corridor instead of death check.
answers.evidence: Intruder Injuries and death; Intruder Retreat

answers.answer: 1. Before moving, resolve one Intruder Attack per Intruder in Room, larger first: Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva. 2. Escape attack targets escaper. 3. If killed, Corpse remains in Room attempted to leave. 4. If survives, move to neighboring Room; explore if needed and Noise roll only if destination empty.

1. Among Characters in Room, target with fewest Action cards; tie: First Player token/next in turn order. 2. Non-Larva draws Attack card; matching Intruder symbol hits and resolves effect, mismatch misses. 3. Larva draws no Attack card: remove mini and place on target board. 4. Target gains Contamination on top of Action discard; if already has Larva, attacking Larva disappears, old Larva stays, target still gains card and does not automatically die.

1. Dressing flips Serious Wound face down and suppresses effect only; it still counts, so further Wound at 3 Serious Wounds kills. 2. Third Light clears Light track and gives Serious Wound. 3. Heal removes a Light Wound or a Dressed Serious Wound as specified. 4. Death leaves Corpse Object in Room and drops Heavy Objects there; Item cards disappear from game.
answers.evidence: Character Wounds and death; FAQ Rules 24

answers.answer: 1. Canteen/Shower scan all Contamination cards in HAND; remove scanned non-Infected cards. Infected stays; if no Larva place one, if Larva already present die and place Creeper in Room. 2. Surgery scans cards in deck, hand, discard; removes all infected and removes Larva if present. 3. Then suffer 1 Light Wound, automatically pass, shuffle all cards including hand and remaining Contamination into Action deck; hand empty until next turn.

1. Shoot or Melee in Room with uncarried Eggs; each Injury destroys one Egg. 2. Grenade destroys 2 Eggs, Molotov 1; Fire destroys 1 Egg per Fire Damage step (2 with Vulnerability to Fire). 3. Successful Egg Melee retains ordinary Contamination draw; missed Egg Melee causes neither Contamination nor Wound, but draw timing is unresolved. 4. After every attempt to destroy an Egg, roll Noise. 5. When no Eggs remain on Intruder board, Nest is destroyed; mark with 1 Injury.
answers.evidence: Eggs and the Nest; source limitations on missed Egg Melee

answers.answer: 1. Pay 2 cards for Evacuation Room Action; Pod must be unlocked, free space, no Intruder or Malfunction in Section. Roll Noise first; an Intruder appearing/reaching Section makes attempt fail. 2. On boarding may launch immediately. 3. Each Pod holds 2 Characters; Heavy Objects use no Character space. 4. If wait, pass current turn; present in Section for bag-development Noise. At start of later Player Phase round choose remain/pass, launch, or exit free and take 2 Actions. Intruder in Section returns pod occupants to Room; Malfunction still allows waiting, launch, exit but prevents new entry.

1. Victory checks: Engines, Coordinates, Contamination, Objectives. 2. Two or three Damaged Engines explode ship; everyone/everything aboard dies, launched pod passengers already away. 3. Non-Earth kills hibernators; Quarantine Objective sleeper survives at Mars. 4. Every survivor including Pod passenger: no existing Larva => scan every Contamination card in deck/hand/discard; if any infected or Larva existed, shuffle all Action and Contamination cards across zones and draw top 4; any Contamination among four kills. Noninfected scans alone do not remove cards. 5. Pod passengers do require final contamination procedure.

1. Face-down shuffled Room 2 tiles on slots marked 2, then Room 1 tiles on 1 slots; place one face-down Exploration token on each; extras returned unseen. 2. Random Coordinates face down; Destination marker on B; Time on green space. 3. Each Engine has shuffled face-down Working/Damaged tokens stacked, top true. Intruder board starts 5 Eggs and 3 random Weakness cards face down.

1. Random Help card numbered 1 through player count assigns Player Number/order; matching Inventory. 2. In number order draft: each draws/reveals 2 Character choices, keeps one, shuffles other back. 3. Character mini starts Hibernatorium; gets 10-card deck, Weapon loaded to capacity in Hand, and 2 Quest Items horizontal/inactive. Blue Corpse starts Hibernatorium. 4. Quest Items are not usable until mini-quest activates them.

1. At Player Phase start draw to 5 (6 if Cabins effect). 2. Then pass First Player token left, except first game turn. 3. If Action deck empty, shuffle discard into new deck when drawing. 4. Normal discards face up: used Actions/Contamination atop own Action discard; Items to matching Item discard; Events, Attack, Wounds to respective discard; markers to pool. Exceptions include Search rejected Item face down to bottom of deck. Inventory Items hidden; used Items shown.

1. Advance Time and Self-Destruct if active; Intruder attacks; Fire damage; Event card movement then effect; bag development. 2. Event-symbol Intruders not in Room with Characters move. 3. Corridor number on card directs; Technical Corridor movement returns token to bag/removes mini. Resolve event effect after movement. 4. Empty Event deck reshuffles discards; empty Intruder Attack deck reshuffles its discards when needed.

1. Larva removed from bag, add Adult; Creeper removed, add Breeder. Adult returns to bag immediately before all players roll Noise in order, skipping Combat; encounter may draw that Adult. Breeder: players roll in order skipping Combat, then return token. 2. Queen in Nest with Character: place Queen and resolve Encounter; otherwise add Egg to board; return Queen token. 3. Blank adds Adult if available then returns Blank. 4. These rolls finish before next turn begins.

1. If no marker available and instructed to place 9th Fire or Malfunction, ship ends/explodes. 2. A Room has max one of each; extra placement does nothing. 3. Removed markers return to pool. 4. Hull loss kills all Characters aboard including sleepers and all else aboard including Intruders.

1. Malfunction disables Room Action and Computer; Search remains usable (except special no-search Rooms). 2. Never place in Nest/Slime Room or unexplored Rooms. 3. Does not alter Engine token/status. 4. Hibernatorium Malfunction does not harm or wake already-hibernating Character.

1. Normal Item cards in Inventory hidden; others see backs/colors. No size limit. 2. Any Item used must be shown. Heavy Items/Objects are public and occupy one of two Hand slots; found Weapons have 1 Ammo, never above capacity. 3. Add Items attach and act as one; Duct Tape combines two Heavy Items into one slot, not Objects.

1. Dropped Objects stay in Room; dropped Items are discarded/lost. 2. Drop any time on your turn, free, no Action. 3. Searched Weapon starts with 1 Ammo; Starting Weapon starts at printed capacity; neither can exceed capacity.

1. Search deck matches Room color; white Room choose Red, Yellow, Green. 2. Draw 2, keep 1, return other face down to bottom. 3. Each Search lowers Item Counter by one; at zero ordinary Search impossible. 4. Scout Scavenging exception; Special Rooms cannot be searched; Blue Crafted Items not searchable. Nest and Slime Room prohibit any Search.

1. Craft Basic Action costs 1 Action card plus two Item cards with matching blue Component icons. 2. Result must be available; otherwise cannot craft. 3. Craft deck may be looked through at any time. 4. Crafted: Antidote flame+medical cross; Taser battery/lightning+tool; Flamethrower flame+tool; Molotov flame+fabric.

1. Only initiating Character pays one Action card. 2. All Characters in Room may mutually agree to trade, including non-initiators. 3. Gifts without exchange allowed; empty action without intended exchange disallowed, though honest negotiation may yield no trade. 4. Ammo cannot be exchanged. 5. Heavy Items from Search need no separate Pick Up Action; that Action is for Objects.
answers.evidence: Trade; FAQ Actions 1–2; Pick Up Heavy Object

answers.answer: 1. Corpse, Egg, or Carcass corresponds to Weakness card. 2. Object must be in Laboratory Room to Analyse. 3. Object is retained, not consumed. 4. Revealed Weakness stays face up and benefits all players. 5. Any player may research the corresponding Object before game end to satisfy Discover Weakness Objective; you need not do it personally.

1. Generally present in Room, pay 2 Action cards, not in Combat or Malfunctioning Room. 2. Computer icon has no independent effect; used by effects such as Motivation. 3. Fire does not generally prevent Room Action or Search; Character ending round there takes Light Wound.
1. Add ammo to one of your Energy Weapons. 2. Add 2 Ammo. 3. Cannot recharge Classic Weapons or exceed Weapon capacity.

1. Choose one Emergency Room option: Dress all Serious Wounds; Heal one Dressed Serious Wound; or Heal all Light Wounds. 2. Dressing only suppresses Wound effect; card still counts toward 3 Serious Wounds. 3. Identical Serious Wound effects do not stack.
1. Send Signal places a Status marker on your Character board's Signal space. 2. This is used only for Objectives. 3. Comms Room is always aboard in standard game.

1. Fire Control chooses any Room and discards its Fire marker if present. 2. All Intruders in chosen Room run away in random directions, drawing one Event card per Intruder. 3. Works even if no Fire, still scattering Intruders.

1. Generator starts by placing marker on green first space; stop removes it; restart begins at green. 2. Advance one space each Time advance. First yellow makes sequence unstoppable and Pods unlock; may relock, and later yellow spaces do not unlock again. Final skull explodes ship. 3. Jump while active still counts ship destroyed. 4. Character cannot start while anyone hibernates; Coolant Leak Event can.

1. Target any other Yellow Room. 2. Its connected Corridors must have no Destroyed Door. 3. Close all Doors around it and place Procedure token. 4. If all remain closed at end of current Player Phase, everything there dies and Fire removed; opening any Door first cancels procedure.
1. At start of new turn, Character in Cabins with no Intruders draws one extra card, hand size 6. 2. Malfunction disables. 3. Passive effect, not a paid Room Action.

1. Command Center can select any Room. 2. May choose which connected Corridor Doors to open or close individually. 3. Destroyed Doors cannot be closed again (except Plasma Torch); summary does not specifically state Command Center exception, so it cannot close a Destroyed Door.
1. Engine Control Room checks status of all three Engines but cannot change them. 2. Check works even if an Engine Room has Malfunction.

1. Hatch Control flips one Pod Locked/Unlocked. 2. Monitoring Room secretly looks at any one unexplored Room tile and Exploration token; explored locations not specified as eligible. 3. Replace them after looking; may lie about what saw.

1. No Action needed: entering Room Covered With Slime automatically gives Slime. 2. No Item count; Malfunction cannot be placed there. 3. Slime max one; further does nothing. 4. Showering does not remove Fire.
answers.evidence: Room Covered With Slime; Shower Room; Slime marker

answers.answer: 1. Check Coordinates secretly views Coordinates card and may lie; Set Destination moves marker. 2. Secret check may be lied about. 3. Destination marker selects one of four entries on Coordinates card. 4. Cannot Set Destination with Intruder in Cockpit or once anyone hibernates.

1. Check Engine secretly views top token; repair/break secretly views both and restacks in any order. 2. May keep whether repaired secret. 3. Must announce if order changed. 4. No prior check or functioning Engine Room required; works with Malfunction.

1. Hibernate only on blue Time space, in Hibernatorium, no Intruder or Malfunction; pay 2 cards. 2. Roll Noise; Intruder appearance/reaching Room fails attempt. 3. Success removes mini and ends participation until end checks. 4. Once anyone hibernates, cannot change Destination or initiate Self-Destruct as Character. 5. Later Malfunction does not wake or harm sleeper.

1. Time final red: ship jumps immediately; non-hibernating aboard Characters die from g-force. 2. Last alive non-hibernating Character aboard dying/hibernating/launching ends game; advance active Self-Destruct to final, otherwise Time to final, resolve. 3. Intruders die if ship destroyed, not from normal jump. 4. Active Self-Destruct at hyperspace jump still means ship destroyed.

1. Characters cannot directly attack other Characters. 2. Indirect harm is possible. 3. Examples: lock someone in burning Room, activate Self-Destruct with crew aboard, or throw Grenade into Room with crew.

1. If all eight Adult models on board, Adults not in Combat retreat: remove them and return tokens to bag if possible, then place one in Encounter Room. If all eight are in Combat, summary explicitly leaves procedure unresolved. 2. Intruder moving into unexplored Room remains; do not reveal tile/token.
answers.evidence: Adult overflow; Intruders in unexplored Rooms

answers.answer: 1. Small curled symbol hits Larva/Creeper only; miss other types. 2. Larger curved symbol hits Larva/Creeper/Adult; miss Breeder/Queen. 3. In Melee same restrictions; ineligible target is a miss and gives Character 1 Serious Wound.

requested_parts: final scan with no Larva/no infected
answers.answer: 1. No Larva: scan every Contamination card in Action deck, hand and discard. If none infected, no four-card draw. 2. Scanned non-Infected cards are not removed. 3. Launched Pod survivor still does final Contamination and Objective checks.
1. Antidote: flame + medical cross. 2. Taser: battery/lightning + screwdriver/tool. 3. Flamethrower: flame + screwdriver/tool. 4. Molotov Cocktail: flame + folded cloth/fabric.

1. In Combat whenever any Intruder shares your Room; Eggs are not Intruders. 2. In Combat Only/Out of Combat Only restrictions must be followed. 3. Unmarked card and Item Actions usable either way subject to requirements; Room Actions forbidden in Combat. 4. Eggs do not cause Combat.

1. Objective saying Player X cannot survive requires that character be dead at end; you need not personally kill them. 2. Hibernating or escaped counts as surviving, not dead. 3. Only survivor means no other Character survives. 4. Your Character must still survive and fulfill objective regardless.
1. If pool empty, move any Door token from elsewhere on board. 2. Open is no token; Closed is standing; Destroyed is lying. 3. Max one Door per Corridor; cannot place in Technical Corridors.

1. First Character death automatically unlocks all Pods immediately. 2. They may later be Locked/Unlocked normally, e.g. Hatch Control. 3. Later death re-unlock after relocking is unresolved due conflicting English source; first-death wording in rule and other-language manuals but English Escape section says any death.

1. Storage Room Action draws two cards from chosen Red/Yellow/Green deck, keeps one. 2. Other goes face down to bottom of chosen deck. 3. Room Action costs 2 Action cards, requires presence, unavailable in Combat or Malfunction Room. Storage action works even counter zero.

1. Nest Room Action takes one Egg token from Intruder board. 2. Costs 2 Action cards (Room Action). 3. Then roll Noise. 4. Previously dropped Egg in Room is Heavy Object; pick up with Basic Pick Up Heavy Object for 1 card, no Noise instruction, and it does not restore board Egg total.
answers.evidence: Nest Room Action; Pick Up Heavy Object; Egg rules

answers.answer: 1. Pay Item's printed Action-card cost and show Item to all players. 2. One Use Only Item is discarded after use.
1. A launched Pod passenger counts as arriving on Earth. 2. This does not mean the ship reached Earth; ship Coordinates and engine checks are separate.
1. Yes. Waiting Character remains treated as present in Section for Noise rolls during bag development, including Adult-triggered roll; Combat skip condition applies if relevant.
1. Already waiting occupant may still wait, launch or exit. 2. Section Malfunction prevents only new entry to Pods.
1. Resolve one separate Intruder Attack per Intruder. 2. Larger first: Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva.
1. Yes. Event that says remove itself is removed even if its other effect cannot be resolved.
1. Adult token returns to bag immediately before players roll Noise. 2. Encounter from those rolls may draw that same Adult token.
1. Retreating Intruder meeting Closed Door destroys it and stays. 2. Under The Way of Moving Weakness affected Intruder other than Breeder/Queen does nothing at Door.
1. No. 2. Hand Serious Wound increases Item Action cost; Basic Shoot is a Basic Action, not Item Action.
1. Vulnerability to Fire adds 1 Injury per damage instance. 2. Flamethrower double-crosshair hit deals 3 Injuries total.

1. Attacking Larva disappears and is placed on Character board only if none already. 2. If one already there, existing remains and attacker disappears. 3. Character gains one Contamination card and does not automatically die.
1. Sleeper does not take later Fire wounds in Hibernatorium. 2. Ship destruction and endgame survival checks can still kill them.
1. Yes, Coolant Leak Event can start Self-Destruct despite hibernating Character. 2. Character cannot initiate it while anyone hibernates.
1. Discarded/dead Intruder tokens return to unused token pool. 2. They remain reusable, not permanently removed.
1. Fire markers can be placed in unexplored Rooms. 2. Malfunction markers cannot.

requested_parts: two Light Wounds received at two Light Wounds
answers.answer: 1. Third Light clears Light track and becomes 1 Serious Wound; fourth Light remains as 1 Light Wound. Final: one Serious plus one Light.
1. Heavy Objects drop in death Room. 2. Item cards disappear from game.
1. No. Pods unlock only when Self-Destruct first reaches a yellow space; later yellow spaces do not unlock again even if relocked.
answers.evidence: Self-Destruct point of no return; FAQ Rules 25

answers.answer: 1. Ship destruction fulfills kill-Queen and destroy-Nest requirements. 2. Your Character must still survive and fulfill all other Objective requirements to win.
1. No, cannot spend empty Trade with no intention of exchange; Actions without meaningful game-state change disallowed. 2. Honest negotiations may end without a trade.
1. Quest activation is a Basic Action printed on card. 2. Forbidden in Combat. 3. Allowed in Malfunctioning Room because it is not Room Action.

1. Basic Shoot, Melee, and Basic Movement as Escape can be used. 2. Cannot Trade, Craft, pick up Heavy Object, or activate Quest Item. 3. Unmarked card/Item Actions may be used in either Combat state subject to requirements; marked restrictions apply. Room Actions prohibited.
1. Soldier may use Covering Fire on themselves alone. 2. Both moving Characters choose direction. 3. Perform one Noise roll; if Encounter, Surprise comparison uses Soldier's hand.
1. Remove all Ammo and perform one Shoot Action; damage adds Shoot result, half discarded Ammo rounded down, and Assault Rifle +1. 2. All Ammo is consumed.

1. May see Intruder Attack card before choosing Nerves of Steel. 2. It can protect Soldier when another Character triggered Surprise Attack, but only Soldier benefits; others still take effects such as Frenzy.

1. Careful Movement replaces automatic Silence/Danger result with its chosen Noise placement; Reconnaissance cancels those automatic results too. 2. Movement ability governs; token's automatic result does not apply.
1. Captain cannot use Order while personally in Combat. 2. Intercom may make another Character Move out of Combat. 3. They must use normal Escape procedure, including attacks before move.
1. All Characters in Rooms with a Computer, and all Characters in Captain's Room, may draw Action card under Motivation with active Intercom.
1. Ignore Door Exploration token when entering via Technical Corridors Action or Technical Corridor Plans, because entry Corridor cannot be determined; no Door placed.
1. Cannot Interrupt Captain Order played remotely via Intercom if not in same Room as Character performing interrupted Action. 2. Passing does not bar Interruption; it remains allowed if same Room.
1. No, empty hand after two Actions does not automatically pass until next round. 2. That extra round may incur another Fire or Bleeding effect.

requested_parts: multiple infected Rest scan without Larva
answers.answer: 1. No; if no Larva before Rest, multiple infected scans place just one Larva and do not by themselves kill. 2. Rest can be fatal if Larva was already on board before Action.

requested_parts: Noise roll location from neighboring Room
answers.answer: 1. Roll Noise in your own Room, not Nest, when throwing Grenade/Molotov at Eggs from another Room.
1. No. Object itself must be in Laboratory to research, regardless of Scientist's location; carrying it outside Lab cannot reveal Weakness.

1. Yes, Storage Room Action may be used repeatedly at zero counter, paying cost and normal restrictions. 2. Counter limits Search Action card; ordinary Search lowers counter and cannot be done at zero (except Scavenging).

requested_parts: Nest Fire Egg destruction with Vulnerability
answers.answer: 1. Two Eggs are destroyed per Fire Damage step when Nest is on Fire and Vulnerability to Fire discovered.

requested_parts: Egg dropped into Nest and total
answers.answer: 1. No. Taken board Egg token dropped in Nest is a normal Heavy Object and does not restore Nest Egg total/hit points.
1. Each affected player chooses one Action card from their own hand. 2. They discard it to their own Action discard pile.
1. Yes, Medkit may be used on another Character. 2. Yes, Bandages may be used on another Character.
1. No, cannot use your Energy Charge directly to reload another Character's Weapon. 2. Trade them the Charge; they use it in their own round.
1. No Larva is placed. 2. Instead gain a new Contamination card.
1. Yes. Adding Extended Magazine or Auto Loader to already-used or empty Energy Weapon immediately grants extra Ammo.
1. Crafted Flamethrower starts fully loaded, not with one Ammo of searched Weapon.

requested_parts: Hand Wound effect on Motion Scanner
answers.answer: 1. No effect on Scout Motion Scanner. 2. It is a unique reaction, not an Item Action.

1. Antidote scans all Contamination in hand, deck, discard. 2. Remove all Infected cards from game. 3. Gain one new Contamination. 4. Reshuffle new card with non-Infected scanned Contamination and Action cards, except cards retained in hand. 5. Then pass; may keep hand cards. 6. Surgery also scans all zones and removes Infected, removes Larva if present, but gives no new Contamination; suffers 1 Light Wound and shuffles entire hand and remaining cards, then passes with empty hand.

1. Slime marker goes on Character board; Fire and Malfunction markers in entered Room. 2. Door token goes in Corridor by which Character entered. 3. Malfunction cannot be placed in unexplored Room; Fire may; Doors never Tech Corridors.

1. Each Intruder in burning Room takes 1 Injury per Event Phase Fire Damage step. 2. This follows Intruder Attacks and precedes Event card. 3. Immediately perform normal Injury Effect check, including possible death/retreat.
1. No Search Action in Nest. 2. No Search Action in Room Covered With Slime, despite ordinary Room Search rules.
